# Acknowledgements {.unnumbered}

Malcolm McLeod started drafting an update to the third edition of this handbook in 2019, with the support of Gerard Grealish and Sam Carrick. The project paused during the Covid-19 pandemic but resumed under Lauren O’Brien in 2023, with the support of the Soil Description Working Group. Members of the group are (in alphabetical order): Sam Carrick, Kirstin Deuss, Andre Eger, David Lowe, Lauren O’Brien, Matt Oliver and Balin Robertson. Additional contributions were gratefully received from Megan Balks, Olivia Burge, Thomas Caspari, Jo Cavanagh, Michelle Collins, Scott Fraser, David Glenny, Linda Lilburne, Kaleb McCollum, Emily Mackay, James Moloney, Nathan Odgers, Alan Palmer, Alistair Ritchie, Hadee Thompson-Morrison, Anthony Ward, and Trevor Webb. Ray Prebble greatly supported the copyediting, proofing and formatting, and Nicolette Faville provided many of the new and updated graphics.
